mapper.insert: insert into student(NAME, NO, GENDER, PHONE, ID_CARD, IS_COLLEGE, ADDRESS, DEGREE, GRADUATION_DATE, CLAZZ_ID, VIOLATION_COUNT, VIOLATION_SCORE, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME) values (#{stu.name}, #{stu.no}, #{stu.gender},#{stu.phone},#{stu.idCard},#{stu.isCollege},#{stu.address},#{stu.degree},#{stu.graduationDate},#{stu.clazzId},#{stu.violationCount},#{stu.violationScore},#{stu.createTime}, #{stu.updateTime})
mapper.select: select id, name, no, gender, phone, id_card, is_college, address, degree, graduation_date, clazz_id, violation_count, violation_score, create_time, update_time from student where id = #{id}
